title: Patch Notes 1.29.0
body:
# Patch Notes 1.29.0

Raiders!

The whispers turned out to be accurate. Having steered clear of underground travel for a long time, the Nomadic Envoys have now set foot in Speranza. These enigmatic figures from the nomadic tribe are searching for prized gear and firearms, and in return they bring bargains you won't find anywhere else.

# What's New?

## New Trader - Nomadic Envoy

Ermal, one of the Nomadic Envoys, has set up camp in Speranza and brought along a selection of enticing Topside trades.

Raiders who have hit Level 25 can trade high-value ARC materials and any rare weapons they've been holding onto for rewarding offers:

* Expanded Stash space (this resets once you head out on an expedition)

* Expedition Vault access - lets Raiders securely stash up to 5 of their most valuable items to collect after the Expedition ends

Ermal also has a selection of trades that rotate weekly:

* Cosmetics

* Blueprints

* Raider Tokens

* Gameplay and progression items, including items tied to current Raider projects

Ermal will keep returning each week with fresh stock as he stays in touch with his fellow Nomads. Make sure to check his offers before he moves on!

**Dev Note:**

We'll be watching your feedback and the data closely to keep the balance fair and challenging.

During the first week, only a single Stash expansion and 5 expedition vault spaces will be up for grabs. This lets us gather early feedback and adjust pricing before we open up more space.

Offers will cycle in and out. If you miss a deal this week, it might come back around in a later rotation.

## New Grenade Launcher - The Rascal

Tian Wen has been busy in her workshop again. Say hello to the Rascal, the newest weapon for taking down armored ARC threats.

This unconventional launcher is light, compact, and easy to carry, and it hits hard despite its quirks. It reloads more slowly and its aim can be a little unpredictable, but the Rascal makes for a dependable side-arm for anyone who wants anti-ARC firepower without hauling around a Hullcracker.

Also included:

* Mod Improvement: Extended Barrel

* End of Round Changes

* The Sandveil Set

* Facial Hair Style - Sideburns

* The Sheath Set, arriving June 2nd

# Patch Highlights

* Fixed a bug that teleported players when they stood on destroyed ARC parts.

* Lowered the power cost of Photoelectric Cloak from 10/s to 5/s.

* Made adjustments to weapon durability.

* Queen and Matriarch will now step over obstacles more often instead of through them, cutting down on unfair knockback for players.

* Added a way to block players after submitting a report.

* Shared an update on security and anti-cheat.

# Balance Changes

## ARC

* Made ARC vision through bushes and smoke more precise, rewarding good positioning. Raiders positioned near the edge of cover are now spotted more easily, while those tucked deeper into foliage or smoke are harder to detect.

* Improved how ARC picks up sound in open outdoor areas, while lowering their sensitivity to indoor sounds and sounds passing through geometry.

* Refined how the Firefly's fire effect works. It now lines up better with the visuals, and briefly clipping the flame no longer feels as harsh, cutting down on the sense of being hit from around corners.

* When the Rocketeer fires multiple missiles at once, they now spread out consistently across a wider area, preventing unfair cases where several missiles land in the same spot.

## Gameplay

* Lowered the power cost of Photoelectric Cloak from 10/s to 5/s.

* Changed the Cloud of Renewal effect on the Tactical Mk. 3 (Healing) Augment into an AoE effect.

* Raised Cloud of Renewal healing from 20 to 45.

* Increased the cooldown on Cloud of Renewal from 30s to 45s.

* Adjusted the shield capacity on the Combat Mk.3 (Flanking) Augment so it now accepts Medium Shields.

* Dev note: As noted in the Patch 1.26 notes, we're still focused on Augments that are underperforming. This update gives the Tactical Mk.3 (Healing) Augment more utility to match its role as a support Augment. You can now heal allies (and enemies too, if you're careless) after being revived. We've also boosted the survivability of the Combat Mk.3 (Flanking) Augment to make it a stronger option for flanking play.

## Weapons

* Increased the Bettina's Base Fire Rate from 235 to 250.

The durability changes from the last patch clearly hit some weapons harder than intended. This update targets the biggest offenders that were breaking too fast, extending their lifetime to bring them closer in line with other weapons.

We'll keep watching your feedback and monitoring for durability issues in the weeks ahead, and will keep making adjustments as needed.

* Weapon mods can now affect aim-down-sights transition speed on scoped weapons.

* Extended Barrel:

* Bullet Velocity Bonus raised from 25 to 30%.

* Damage fall off distance increased by 15%.

* Renamed to Extended Barrel III.

* Given a new mesh.

* Added two lower-tier versions:

* Extended Barrel I

* Extended Barrel II

# Content and Bug Fixes

## ARC

* Fixed flying ARC occasionally getting stuck.

* Queen and Matriarch will now step over obstacles more often instead of through them, cutting down on unfair knockback for players.

* When Raiders first spawn into a session, ARC will notice them less and be less likely to engage right away.

* Fixed some cases of ARC spawning in unexpected spots.

* Fixed ARC Turbine legs turning invisible at certain angles.

* Improved the ARC Turbine's ability to find good leg angles when landing.

* Improved ARC Turbine landing positions to reduce visual clipping.

* Increased the chance of Raiders getting burned by the ARC Turbine while inside it.

## Animation

* Updated cloth physics on character outfits for smoother, more natural movement.

* Fixed ARC weapon rotations snapping and appearing laggy in some cases.

* Fixed items clipping into Field Crates when picked up while holding a gadget.

## Audio

* Reduced how much sound gets muffled while taking damage.

* Added a distinct sound cue for when Bastion and Bombardier switch targets.

* Added comb filtering to footsteps and movement sounds for clearer sense of distance, elevation, and direction.

* Improved binaural audio so it's easier to tell the height and elevation of sounds.

## Cosmetics

* Continued work to unify character texture settings for better performance and more consistent visuals.

## Gameplay

* Players are now immune to stuns while entering a Raider Hatch, so they won't be interrupted while returning to Speranza.

* Fixed downed players being able to move out of bounds.

* Fixed fire inputs not buffering when pressed during actions like dodgeroll or climbing.

## General

* Fixed a bug that teleported players when they stood on destroyed ARC parts.

* Fixed characters floating when disconnecting mid-air.

* Fixed the Expedition timer showing an incorrect duration.

## Items

* Agave Juice now Quick Moves into available Quick Use slots instead of the Backpack, and won't be unloaded from the Backpack when emptying it.

* Free loadout Augment sell price raised from 100 to 660.

## Maps

* Fixed low-res textures, odd spray paint decals, and a misaligned wall in tunnel and highway areas.

* Fixed overly dark shading on vent materials to improve visibility.

* Fixed a balcony structure clipping into a hotel doorway that could block passage.

* Fixed floating objects and improved rope visuals and physics.

* Fixed a misaligned balcony in the hotel lobby and missing wall collision at Room 207.

* Polished environment textures and fixed collision issues.

## Social

* Added an option to block players after reporting them.

* Fixed voice chat failing when opening the console UI on PS5/Xbox.

* End of Round Changes:

* Raiders can now see all squad members at the end of the round, whether or not they successfully extracted.

* Interacting with a squad member's name plate now brings up social actions, including reporting, muting, or blocking that player.

* Players can now leave the squad immediately during the tunnel sequence.

## Stability & Performance

* General improvements to performance and stability.

* Fixed a bug that could leave the loading screen stuck.

## UI

* Added information to the Crash Mat tooltip showing the extra safe fall height it grants.

* Deployable previews now display occluded areas with a striped overlay to make placement easier.

* Fixed the ping marker behaving erratically when pinging an ARC Turbine as it entered the map.

## Utility

* Removed an unintended delay after cancelling a Trigger 'Nade throw that prevented the grenade from being thrown or triggered.

* Fixed grenade throws being unable to be cancelled.

* Cancelling deployment of a Pulse Mine or Gas Mine no longer consumes the item.

* Fixed the 'Use Zipline' prompt sometimes not appearing, which blocked interaction at close range.

* Fixed vaulting sometimes triggering while moving upward or while standing still on the ground with the Powered Descender active.

* Fixed the Surge Coil not damaging teammates of the player who placed it.

# Known issues

* Opening the console menu on PS5/Xbox during matchmaking cancels the matchmaking process.

* The Sandveil outfit's scarf may look stretched, with long hairstyles clipping through it.

* Players can fall out of the map by walking near the wall of Pilgrim Peak's building.

* The Successful Extraction music plays in the background when the new Trader Introduction video appears after returning to the main menu.

* Characters on the Squad Walk screen may sometimes fail to appear.

* Dolabra does not deal damage to training dummies on the Practice Range.

* The pause on an Augment's Regen Effect fails to apply after a player is revived.

* The throw animation may not play if a player tries to detonate a Trigger 'Nade right after throwing it.

* Various localization issues remain across the UI, including missing text in the settings menu and loading screen quotes.

* In rare cases, purchases may not work in the customization screen; reopening the screen resolves this.

* The Firefly may occasionally vanish after going idle and drop an incendiary grenade.

* Shredders float up to the ceiling in some rooms of the Hidden Bunker.

* Player animations may look broken when a search of the Baron Husk is interrupted.

* The Leaper is able to jump through the ARC Turbine.

# An Update on Security & Anti-cheat

As mentioned in our recent Ensuring Fair Play article, we're continuing to improve our anti-cheat tools to more accurately catch foul play across the Rust Belt.

Following a successful launch in THE FINALS, Denuvo Anti-Cheat will also arrive in ARC Raiders starting May 19th. It will initially reach a limited pool of players, with plans to expand it further after close monitoring.

We will not be using Denuvo's Digital Rights Management (DRM) service, and we're working to keep any performance impact to a minimum.

With Denuvo Anti-Cheat alongside Anybrain, we're working to make ARC Raiders' systems even stronger. Please keep sending us any information you think could help with this, it is genuinely appreciated.

See you topside Raiders, //Ossen
